about.title: About Brookstone Construction
text: The Cathedral High School includes the construction of a two-story private high school building which contains class rooms, parish hall/gymnasium, commercial kitchen, library and common areas, administration offices. The project has approximately 49,286 SF of floor area, renovations of approximately 420 SF of adjacent building, and includes related site improvements. This marks the fifth project Brookstone has completed for Our Lady of Walsingham.

The majority of Brookstone’s projects are executed using “alternative project delivery systems,” such as Construction Manage- at-Risk, Design-Build, and Negotiated Cost-of-the-Work Plus a Fee with a Guaranteed Maximum Price. Using these delivery systems Brookstone has the opportunity and experience to provide valuable preconstruction services as a project team member during the design phase of the project.

Our vision is simple - we build solutions and solve problems for our clients! We are experienced, proactive, team-oriented and thrive with opportunities to leverage our experience and skills for our clients’ benefit. We relish the challenge of discovering solutions missed by others. There are infinite possibilities for problem solving. We help our clients build the right one.
